_comment: Spec 044-01 — a REDACTED, REAL-SHAPED (not real) fixture standing in for a container's Google Ads (AW) gtag.js `ccm/collect` page-load beacon (a page_view) PLUS the _gcl_au conversion-linker cookie gtag.js read to produce its `auid`. Real captures are local-only and uncommittable (ADR-0018 R5): the AW conversion id (tid), the auid, and the _gcl_au cookie value below are clearly-synthetic all-zero placeholders carrying only the real AW ccm/collect field VOCABULARY, per rig/parity/redact-google-ads.js's redactAwBeacon(). No live identifier of any kind appears in this file — see test/parity-google-ads.test.js's redaction coverage. The A1 endpoint choice (ccm/collect, over the viewthroughconversion/rmkt mirror pair and the ccm/form-data enhanced-conversions channel) is grounded on the 2026-09-11 R-009 §(b) erp.intuit.com capture and justified in connectors/google-ads/connector.js. auid is DERIVED from the _gcl_au cookie below (parseGclAuId) — the same first-party-cookie coupling the harness's ctx-sourcing reproduces (rig/parity/google-ads-replay.js), never a beacon back-feed. gcs/gcd/npa carry the LIVE-OBSERVED granted-consent Consent-Mode values (gcs=G111, gcd=13r3r3r3r5l1, npa=0 for the reference page's default-denied config) — these are consent-mode strings, not identifiers, so they are the real observed values.
